x: Roberts, competing in his first big race for us, was 44th, Harley 57th and Ted Saunders 68th. Frank Elson was compelled to retire from the race.
Reeve, is in the R.A.O.C.; whilst Ted Saunders is a corporal in an R.A.M.C. unit functioning in the Near East.

Len Fletcher and Frank Elson have assisted the Club in seven of these eight wins; Tommy Green six times; Fred Rickards on three occasions; Harold King, Frank Thorn and Ted Saunders each twice; and Joe King and Jack Field once each.
